transcript.content:
Subject: Request to Send CSV File

Hi Assistant,

Please send the attached 'NewAccounts_Oct.csv' from the sales thread to our onboarding partner so they can start importing the new accounts.

Thank you!

[Attachment: NewAccounts_Oct.csv]

I can't find that attachment or the sales thread in your inbox/sent with the search terms I tried. A couple quick questions so I can send the CSV correctly:

1. Which onboarding partner should I send this to? Please give the email address (or confirm a contact name in your address book).  
2. Is the file NewAccounts_Oct.csv already in your mailbox (an email in the sales thread) or do you want me to attach a local file you’ll upload now?  
3. If the file is in your mailbox, can you tell me either:
   - the sender or approximate subject of the sales thread, or  
   - forward/email ID or the date it was received — I’ll re-run a targeted search.
4. What should the email subject/body be? If you want a quick default, I can use:
   - Subject: New Accounts CSV for Import (Oct)
   - Body: "Hi — Please find attached NewAccounts_Oct.csv for import into your system. Let me know if you need anything else. Thanks, [Your name]"

Tell me the answers and I’ll locate the attachment and send the message. If you prefer, you can also upload the CSV here and I’ll attach and send it once you provide the recipient and message.

1. The onboarding partner's email is partner@example.com.  
2. The file is not in my mailbox; I’ll upload it now.  
3. I don’t have specifics on the sales thread.  
4. Please use the quick default for the subject and body.

[Uploading the CSV file now...]

Thanks — I’m ready to send as soon as I can access the actual CSV. I don’t currently have a way to attach a local file you upload directly here to an outgoing Gmail message. Two quick options — pick one:

Option A — upload the file into your Gmail inbox so I can attach it
- Send the CSV to your own email address (me@company.com) or forward an email containing the file to me@company.com.  
- Tell me when you’ve sent/forwarded it and I’ll search your inbox, find the attachment, and send the email to partner@example.com with:
  - Subject: New Accounts CSV for Import (Oct)
  - Body: "Hi — Please find attached NewAccounts_Oct.csv for import into your system. Let me know if you need anything else. Thanks, [Your name]"

Option B — provide a shareable link
- Upload NewAccounts_Oct.csv to Google Drive, Dropbox, or another file host and paste a shareable link here (ensure the link allows the recipient to download). I’ll send an email to partner@example.com including the link and the same subject/body above.

Which option do you want? If Option A, tell me after you forward/send the file so I can locate and send it. If you want to change the subject/body or sender name signature, tell me now.
I'll go with Option A. I will send the CSV to my email address now. [END]
